news.title: Nvidia results 'so important' for gauging AI funding fears, expert says
news.summary:
STORY: Haworth said he will be looking for "robust" demand for Nvidia's chips, and whether the company's circular financing structure is sound.

"They've put together a consortium to lend money to businesses to buy their chips," he explained. "How is that working, and should we be less concerned than maybe we were initially about that financing arrangement?"

"There's maybe room for surprise upside in Nvidia," he added.
